memory_bridge: Open the sunlit gap in the gate onto four spaces: a clock hangs there for 時間 with On カン, a crowd beyond it is 世間 with On ケン, the measurable space between the doors is 間 with Kun あいだ, and a dramatic pause in that gap is 間 with Kun ま.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 時間（じかん）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Hang a clock in the sunlit gate gap and label the measured time 時間（じかん）; the final character uses On カン.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 世間（せけん）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Swing the gate open onto the whole social world, 世間（せけん）; its final character uses the other On sound ケン.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 間（あいだ）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Stretch a tape measure across the space between the two doors and call that interval 間（あいだ）; the standalone native word fixes Kun あいだ.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 間（ま）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Pause silently in the narrow gate opening for one perfectly timed 間（ま）; the standalone native word fixes Kun ま as “time” or a pause.
